title: Add note
purpose: Add a note, a file, or both to an excursion's timeline at any stage.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators; viewers are refused. Notes can be added in any state, including after closing. They never change the excursion's status or details. Notes cannot be edited or deleted.

items.label: Note
items.description: Up to 4,000 characters. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

items.label: Attachment
items.description: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV, up to 10 MiB, checked by content and downloaded as a file. Enter a note, attach a file, or both; with neither the form is refused. If the repository has set a limit on the total size of attached files and it would be exceeded, the file is refused and nothing is recorded.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Add note adds a Note or attachment entry to the timeline with your name and the time, and returns to the timeline.
